Where to get the key

Make a free account on thegamesdb.net and ask for an API key there (the key request page is linked from its API documentation). The free allowance is limited per month, and a game costs one or two requests.
Make a free account on steamgriddb.com, sign in and open your profile preferences: the API tab lets you generate a key. SteamGridDB art is community artwork and not always the official box.

IGDB uses Twitch sign-in. Log in at dev.twitch.tv with a Twitch account (two-factor sign-in is required), register an application in the console (category: other, any redirect URL such as http://localhost), then copy its Client ID and make a new secret. Both go in below.
Key already in the app
This app already holds a TheGamesDB key for the game details, so nothing needs to be filled in here: the same key is used. A key of your own below replaces it.
TheGamesDB API key
Your TheGamesDB API key. It is only sent to api.thegamesdb.net and is never put in a backup or a problem report.

Your SteamGridDB API key. It is only sent to steamgriddb.com and is never put in a backup or a problem report.

The Client ID of your Twitch application. It is sent to Twitch and IGDB. It is not a secret, so it may be in a backup.
